subject: DI01000191

intro_text.en: Bilingual teaching notes with construction, working, applications and revision. Exam has questions only. Use supervised models; no actual practical is claimed.
intro_text.gu: English technical keywords સાથે સરળ ગુજરાતી સમજ. Construction, working, applications અને revision. Exam માં માત્ર પ્રશ્નો. Supervised model વાપરો; actual practical નો દાવો નથી.

body.en:
A transmission carries motion/torque from a driver to a driven machine and can change speed, direction or motion form. It does not create energy: real output power is lower than input because of losses. At steady conditions, speed/torque changes are linked through power.

Choose by shaft position, ratio, load, distance, environment, maintenance and safety. A high torque rating does not imply unlimited speed or zero loss.
body.gu:
Transmission driver થી driven સુધી motion/torque આપે; speed/direction/form બદલી શકે. Energy બનાવતું નથી; real losses થી output ઓછું. Steady condition માં speed/torque power થી જોડાય છે.

Shaft position, ratio, load, distance, environment અને maintenance પરથી selection. High torque એટલે unlimited speed/zero loss નહીં.

body.en:
A shaft commonly transmits torque and supports rotating parts, experiencing torsion/bending. An axle primarily supports rotating members; it may be stationary or rotating depending on the design.

A gearbox output shaft transmits drive; an idler-wheel axle can chiefly support load. Automotive drive-axle terminology includes torque transmission, so “every axle is stationary and never transmits torque” is not universal.
body.gu:
Shaft torque transmit/rotating parts support કરે; torsion/bending આવે. Axle મુખ્યત્વે support આપે અને design પ્રમાણે rotate પણ થઈ શકે.

Gearbox output shaft drive આપે; idler-wheel axle support. Vehicle drive axle torque પણ આપે, એટલે every axle stationary rule નહીં.

body.en:
A belt passes over driver/driven pulleys. Friction between suitable belt and pulley transmits tangential force; the two belt sides develop different tensions. Flat, V and toothed/synchronous belts differ in mechanism and geometry.

V belts use a wedging contact arrangement; synchronous belts engage teeth and should not be treated as an ordinary slipping friction belt. Material, tension, alignment and ratings matter. Do not adjust a moving belt or remove guards.
body.gu:
Belt driver/driven pulleys પર જાય. યોગ્ય contact friction tangential force આપે અને બે sides માં tension જુદું થાય. Flat, V અને toothed/synchronous belts અલગ છે.

V belt wedging contact વાપરે; synchronous teeth engage કરે, સામાન્ય slipping friction belt નહીં. Tension/alignment/rating જરૂરી; moving belt adjust નહીં.

body.en:
An open belt between parallel shafts commonly gives the same rotational direction; a crossed arrangement gives opposite directions in the simple teaching layout. Crossed belt suitability depends on belt type, spacing/contact and speed; not every belt tolerates crossing.

Belt drives suit moderate separation, smooth operation and selected shock absorption. Friction belts can slip/creep, so an exact fixed speed ratio is not guaranteed. Avoid contamination, misalignment and excessive tension.
body.gu:
Parallel shafts પર open belt સામાન્ય same rotation; crossed arrangement opposite direction આપે. પરંતુ belt type/contact/speed પ્રમાણે crossing suitability છે; દરેક belt cross ન કરવો.

Moderate distance, smooth operation/shock cushioning માટે યોગ્ય. Friction belt slip/creep થી exact ratio ન જળવાય. Contamination/misalignment/excess tension ટાળો.

body.en:
For a simple no-slip belt with effective pulley diameters, N1D1=N2D2. Thus driven speed N2=N1D1/D2. Use effective/pitch diameter as appropriate, not an arbitrary outer flange dimension.

Example: a 100 mm driver at 1000 rpm drives a 200 mm pulley; ideal N2=500 rpm. Real slip/creep changes the result. The ratio changes torque capability subject to power and component limits; it does not double power.
body.gu:
No-slip simple belt માટે effective diameters સાથે N1D1=N2D2. N2=N1D1/D2. યોગ્ય effective/pitch diameter લો, outer flange size નહીં.

100 mm driver 1000 rpm અને 200 mm driven હોય તો ideal N2=500 rpm. Real slip/creep થી ફેરફાર. Torque/speed trade-off power/limits સાથે છે; power double નથી.

body.en:
A chain engages teeth of driver/driven sprockets. Roller-chain links articulate around sprockets; positive engagement avoids ordinary friction-belt slip, but wear/backlash and polygonal action remain. Lubrication and correct tension/alignment are important.

Suitable uses include bicycles and selected industrial drives. A simple two-sprocket ratio is governed by tooth counts, not smooth pulley diameter. It may be noisier and need more maintenance than a suitable belt; exact choice depends on duty.
body.gu:
Chain driver/driven sprocket teeth engage કરે. Roller-chain links articulate થાય; ordinary friction slip નથી, પણ wear/backlash/polygonal action રહે. Lubrication/tension/alignment જરૂરી.

Bicycle/industrial drives માં ઉપયોગ. Ratio tooth counts પરથી, smooth pulley diameter પરથી નહીં. Noise/maintenance duty પ્રમાણે બદલાય.

body.en:
Pressing suitable wheels together allows tangential friction to transmit motion. In a simple external-contact pair the wheels rotate in opposite directions. Adequate normal force and compatible surfaces are needed.

Advantages include simple contact and smooth engagement in suitable duties; slip limits exact ratios and transmitted force. Unlike toothed gears, it relies on frictional contact rather than tooth engagement. Excess normal force can overload bearings.
body.gu:
યોગ્ય wheels contact માં દબાવતાં friction motion transmit કરે. Simple external pair opposite rotate કરે. Normal force/compatible surface જોઈએ.

Simple/smooth contact લાભ; slip થી exact ratio/force મર્યાદિત. Gears ની જેમ teeth engagement નહીં. વધારે normal force bearings overload કરી શકે.

body.en:
Gears transfer motion through meshing teeth with suitable conjugate geometry. Spur gears commonly connect parallel shafts; helical gears give progressive contact and can impose axial loads; bevel gears commonly connect intersecting shafts; worm arrangements commonly connect non-parallel non-intersecting axes.

The tooth-count ratio sets the ideal angular-speed relation. Gears still have losses, backlash, wear and lubrication needs. Not every worm drive is self-locking; that depends on geometry/friction and must never be assumed for load safety.
body.gu:
Gears matching teeth mesh કરીને motion આપે. Spur સામાન્ય parallel shafts; helical progressive contact/axial load; bevel intersecting અને worm સામાન્ય non-parallel non-intersecting axes માટે.

Tooth count ideal speed ratio આપે. Loss/backlash/wear રહે. દરેક worm self-locking નથી; load safety માટે assume ન કરો.

body.en:
For a simple external gear pair, N1Z1=N2Z2. More driven teeth gives lower driven speed in this arrangement; the two external gears rotate oppositely. An idler may change direction/spacing but not the magnitude of the simple overall tooth ratio.

Example: driver 20 teeth at 600 rpm; driven 60 teeth gives ideal 200 rpm. Internal gears, compound trains and other arrangements require their own analysis; do not apply the direction rule blindly.
body.gu:
Simple external pair માટે N1Z1=N2Z2. Driven teeth વધારે એટલે speed ઓછી; pair opposite rotate કરે. Idler direction/spacing બદલે, simple overall ratio magnitude નહીં.

20 teeth driver 600 rpm અને 60 teeth driven હોય તો ideal200 rpm. Internal/compound arrangements માટે જુદું analysis જોઈએ.

body.en:
Use a belt for suitable separated shafts and smooth/economical duties; chain for positive sprocket drive across a suitable distance; friction wheels for suitable contact duties; gears for compact precise tooth-ratio transmission. Requirements can overlap.

Cover nip/entanglement points. Isolate drive energy before inspection, tension adjustment or model dismantling. Never touch rotating belts/chains/gears or use clothing/hair near exposed motion.
body.gu:
Belt suitable distance/smooth economy, chain positive drive, friction wheels suitable contact અને gears compact tooth-ratio drive માટે. Duties overlap થાય.

Nip/entanglement points guard કરો. Inspection/tension/dismantling પહેલાં energy isolate. Rotating belt/chain/gear ને હાથ નહીં; loose clothing/hair દૂર.

a.en: Tooth counts for the simple pair.

terms.en: Simple gear pair, not every train rule.

Practice: Explain belt slip and speed-ratio assumptions.
Practice: Compare belt, chain, friction and gear drives.
Practice: Calculate ideal speed for 20-tooth driver at 600 rpm and 60-tooth driven; state direction.
